questions.question: Which of the following Odissi dancers is also a master of percussion instruments like Mridangam, Pakhavaj and Tabla?
questions.solution: Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra was not only the architect of modern Odissi dance but also a phenomenal percussionist. He was a master of the Mridangam, Pakhavaj, and Tabla, and his deep understanding of rhythm (Tala) significantly influenced the unique structure of Odissi compositions.

questions.question: Who among the following Indian musicians introduced shehnai to the concert stage and was selected to perform for the ceremony at Delhi’s historic Red Fort on the occasion of India’s Independence Day on 15 August 1947?
questions.solution: Ustad Bismillah Khan is credited with bringing the Shehnai to the global concert stage. He was chosen for the historic honor of playing at the Red Fort on August 15, 1947, as the sun rose on an independent India.

questions.question: Who among the following is known as Sarangi instrumentalist?
questions.solution: Ustad Bundu Khan was a legendary Sarangi player from the Delhi Gharana. He is remembered for his technical innovations and for his deep mastery of the instrument, which was traditionally used only for accompaniment but became a lead solo instrument in his hands.

questions.question: Padma Bhushan awardee Ustad Sabri Khan was a ______ player.
questions.solution: Ustad Sabri Khan was a world-renowned maestro of the Sarangi from the Sainia Gharana. He was awarded the Padma Bhushan for his efforts in promoting Indian classical music internationally.

questions.question: Who among the following is NOT a recipient of Bharat Ratna Award?
questions.solution:
Pandit Kumar Gandharva, though a legendary vocalist known for his unique style and folk-classical fusion, was not awarded the Bharat Ratna.

Note: Ravi Shankar (1999), Bismillah Khan (2001), and Bhimsen Joshi (2008) are all recipients.

questions.question: Who among the following is NOT a Veena player?
questions.solution:
Pandit Jasraj was a world-famous Classical Vocalist of the Mewati Gharana, not a Veena player.

Quick Check: S. Balachander, Veenai Dhanammal, and Jayanthi Kumaresh are all esteemed exponents of the Veena.

questions.question: Ustad Bade Ghulam Ali Khan, often touted as Tansen of the 20th century is famous for which of the following music genres?
questions.solution: Ustad Bade Ghulam Ali Khan was a titan of Hindustani Classical Music. Representing the Patiala Gharana, he was known as the 'Tansen of the 20th Century' for his extraordinary vocal range and command over Khayal and Thumri.

questions.question: What was the name of the first musician to be awarded the prestigious Bharat Ratna, India's highest civilian honour?
questions.solution: M.S. Subbulakshmi was the first musician to be awarded the Bharat Ratna (1998). She was a legendary Carnatic vocalist who was also the first Indian musician to perform at the United Nations General Assembly.

questions.question: पंडित शिवकुमार शर्मा एक शास्त्रीय _________ वादक हैं।
questions.solution: पंडित शिवकुमार शर्मा एक विश्व प्रसिद्ध संतूर (Santoor) वादक थे। उन्होंने संतूर को एक कश्मीरी लोक वाद्य यंत्र से शास्त्रीय संगीत के मुख्य वाद्य यंत्र के रूप में स्थापित किया।

questions.question: Who among the following is India’s only publicly well-known woman shehnai player?
questions.solution: Bageshwari Qamar is recognized as India's first and only prominent woman Shehnai player. She was a disciple of Ustad Bismillah Khan and broke traditional gender barriers associated with the instrument.

questions.question: Who among the following is a sitar player?
questions.solution: Ustad Shahid Parvez Khan is an eminent Sitar player of the Etawah Gharana (Imdadkhani). He is known for the Gayaki Ang style, which replicates the nuances of the human voice on the sitar.

questions.question: Indian music maestro Bhimsen Joshi was related to the________ Gharana.
questions.solution: Pandit Bhimsen Joshi belonged to the Kirana Gharana. He was famous for his powerful voice and his mastery over ragas like Shuddha Kalyan and Miyan Ki Malhar.

questions.question: Who among the following is the best Rudra Veena player in Hindustani Classical Music?
questions.solution: Ustad Asad Ali Khan was arguably the greatest Rudra Veena player in the Khandarbani style of the 20th century. He was a Padma Bhushan awardee who kept this rare and ancient instrument's tradition alive.

questions.question: With which musical instrument can you associate the name of Ali Akbar Khan?
questions.solution: Ustad Ali Akbar Khan was a legendary master of the Sarod. He was a key figure in making Indian classical music popular in the United States and was the first Indian musician to record an LP in the West.

questions.question: Who among the following is NOT a tabla player?
questions.solution:
G. N. Balasubramaniam (GNB) was a legendary Carnatic Vocalist and composer, not a tabla player.

Note: Tanmoy Bose, Swapan Chaudhuri, and Bickram Ghosh are all contemporary masters of the Tabla.

questions.question: Padma Bhushan awardee Pandit Nikhil Jyoti Ghosh was a _________ player.
questions.solution: Pandit Nikhil Jyoti Ghosh was an eminent Tabla player, teacher, and musicologist. He founded the Sangeet Mahabharati institution in Mumbai and was honored with the Padma Bhushan.

questions.question: Ustad Allah Rakha was famous for playing the ___________.
questions.solution: Ustad Alla Rakha was a legendary Tabla player of the Punjab Gharana. He is widely remembered for his long-standing partnership with Pt. Ravi Shankar and for being the father of Ustad Zakir Hussain.

questions.question: पंडित भीमसेन जोशी निम्नलिखित में से किससे संबंधित हैं?
questions.solution: पंडित भीमसेन जोशी का संबंध हिंदुस्तानी शास्त्रीय गायन (Hindustani Classical Vocal) से है। वे किराना घराने के सबसे प्रसिद्ध गायकों में से एक थे।

questions.question: Who among the following is an outstanding player to have mastered the surbahar instrument?
questions.solution: Ustad Imrat Khan was a master of both the Sitar and the Surbahar (a bass sitar). He belonged to the illustrious Etawah Gharana and was known for the deep, meditative resonance he could produce on the surbahar.

questions.question: Pandit Ravi Shankar was one of the best known players of the ________.
questions.solution: Pandit Ravi Shankar was the world's best-known Sitar player. He won five Grammy awards and was a global cultural ambassador, collaborating with Western musicians like George Harrison of The Beatles.

questions.question: Padma Bhushan awardee Vikku Vinayakaram is a __________ player.
questions.solution: T. H. 'Vikku' Vinayakram is a Grammy-winning percussionist who globalized the Ghatam (an earthen clay pot). He is known for his incredible speed and for his work with the fusion band Shakti.

questions.question: Ustad Zakir Hussain is the son of ____________, an Indian tabla player.
questions.solution: Ustad Zakir Hussain is the son of the legendary tabla maestro Ustad Alla Rakha. Zakir Hussain followed in his father's footsteps to become the most famous tabla player in the world.

questions.question: Which of the following classical music instruments is performed by Pandit Shiv Kumar Sharma?
questions.solution: Pandit Shiv Kumar Sharma is the name synonymous with the Santoor. He transformed this percussion-string instrument into a highly sophisticated solo classical instrument.

questions.question: Pandit Pannalal Ghosh also known as Amal Jyoti Ghosh, was a ____________ player and composer.
questions.solution: Pandit Pannalal Ghosh (Amal Jyoti Ghosh) is credited with elevating the Bansuri (bamboo flute) to the status of a classical concert instrument by introducing the larger, seven-holed bass flute.

questions.question: Asad Ali Khan is a maestro of playing ____________.
questions.solution: Ustad Asad Ali Khan was a legendary maestro of the Rudra Veena. He was one of the last few masters of the Dhrupad style played on the ancient Veena.
